scope: Exact legacy recipe outputs and explicit item loot entries matched to modern registered armor identities. Only legacy _legs -> modern _leggings suffix aliases are normalized. Resources do not certify encounter reachability, live obtainability, identical behavior or safe direct porting.

legacy_inventory_reference_proof.basis: Pinned registration title/base pairs plus ArmourSet Helmet/Chestplate/Legs/Boots suffix expansion link to exact localization-key inventory records. Old Boot is a hidden SimpleItem in this source, not an armor-slot implementation.

current_set.interpretation: The released UnobtainableItems.CURRENT_SET is memoized and filtered out of normal AoA creative-tab item lists. Its 92 armor members match the selected recipe-viewer hiding tag. This is upstream classification/presentation behavior, not proof that commands or external datapacks cannot supply them.

limits: The 1.12.2 scan uses assets/aoa3 recipes/loot_tables and accepts its unqualified item entry type; later releases use data/aoa3.
No loot condition, nested selection or encounter availability is flattened into a guaranteed acquisition claim.
Preserve modern item IDs and save mappings; historical input ingredients, skills, mobs, dimensions and stations may need restoration together.
Source presence is not a completed port or tested build.
